description: Transit Resilience for Essential Commuting is a public application for assessing climate exposure at transit stations together with access to hospitals and jobs. Data Clinic built it for a 2022 US transportation resilience sprint. Users can inspect station-specific flood, heat or fire risk and service-access ratings for the cities represented in its processed data. The repository includes application and analysis code plus Apache 2.0 and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence texts. It states that the project is no longer maintained by Two Sigma. A limitation is that some upstream First Street climate-risk products have not had a free tier since early 2024, and source GTFS feeds carry their own terms. Reproducing every processed score may require access beyond this repository. TREC can guide transit resilience scenarios and prioritisation of essential trips. The related catalogue AequilibraE model computes transport-network outcomes but is not this climate-access app. No processed dataset or application bundle was downloaded.
